ma_mental_arithmetic.definition: Doing a calculation in your head, without a calculator and without paper.
ma_mental_arithmetic.example: Mental arithmetic gave me the rough figure, and the check gave me the right one.

mathlit_consistency.definition: The property of a set of axioms that do not contradict one another.
mathlit_consistency.example: The two rules cannot both be true, so the set of rules is not consistent.

refreeze.definition: To put something that has thawed back into the freezer. For meat and fish this is a safety question, not a quality one.
refreeze.example: You can freeze it now, but you cannot refreeze it once it has thawed.

use_by.definition: The date after which the food may no longer be safe to eat. It is a safety date and it is not negotiable.
use_by.example: The use-by date was yesterday, so I threw the chicken away.
